facts.topic: Volume as Effort vs Price as Result
facts.statement: Richard Wyckoff effort versus result invariant: volume represents physical institutional effort, while price spread represents the result.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Volume validates whether a price movement is authentic or engineered by insiders.

facts.statement: Empirical market operation in Chapter 10 Part 2: specialists engineer liquidity events to restock inventory at wholesale prices.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Insiders use news and false breakouts to accumulate at discount.

numericalDetails.context: Volume surge during institutional breakout campaign.

facts.statement: Price spread and volume are the only two leading indicators; all mathematical derivatives (oscillators and moving averages) are lagging by definition.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Price and volume lead all derived technical indicators.

facts.statement: A Volume Price Analysis anomaly occurs when wide spread price movement occurs on low volume, or narrow spread consolidation absorbs high volume.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Anomalies reveal divergence between retail price expectations and insider capital deployment.

facts.statement: While quote prices can be artificially moved on thin liquidity, institutional transaction volume must physically clear on the exchange tape.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Volume cannot be hidden; it is transparently recorded on the tape.

generalAssumptions: Markets are actively manipulated by institutional insiders and market makers.
Volume is the physical validation of trading effort.
Human fear and greed repeat consistently across market eras.
